_about: What each Launch Kit file is for, in the customer's words. Keyed by '<part>/<file name>' ('root/' for the top of the zip). 'keep' ranks what stays when the zip has to shrink: 1 stays longest. The handover's tests check that every kit output the registry (src/lib/launchKit.js) sends has an entry.

root/handover.pdf.label: Handover guide
root/handover.pdf.what: This guide: what we built, your links, how to edit, and what to do first.
root/handover.pdf.use: Start here. Print the checklist pages if you like ticking boxes.

root/README.txt.label: Read me
root/README.txt.what: A plain-text list of every folder in this kit.
root/README.txt.use: Open it if you're not sure which file is which.

brand/brand-board.png.label: Brand board
brand/brand-board.png.what: Your colors and fonts on one page, the way your site uses them.
brand/brand-board.png.use: Send it to anyone who makes something for you (sign shop, wrap installer, printer) so it matches your site.

brand/brand-colors.txt.label: Brand colors and fonts
brand/brand-colors.txt.what: Your color codes and font names as plain text.
brand/brand-colors.txt.use: Copy them into an email to a sign shop, printer or anyone who designs for you.

photos/contact_sheet.png.label: Photo contact sheet
photos/contact_sheet.png.what: Your photos side by side, marked with the picks and crops we suggested for your site.
photos/contact_sheet.png.use: See which of your shots work best and which ones are worth retaking.

mobile/contact.vcf.label: Contact card
mobile/contact.vcf.what: Your business as a phone contact.
mobile/contact.vcf.use: Text or email it to customers so they can save your number in one tap.

mobile/apple-touch-icon.png.label: iPhone home-screen icon
mobile/apple-touch-icon.png.what: Your icon sized for iPhone home screens (180 x 180).
mobile/apple-touch-icon.png.use: Keep it with your brand files; whoever builds pages for you can add it.

mobile/icon-192.png.label: App icon, small
mobile/icon-192.png.what: Your icon at 192 x 192 for Android home screens.
mobile/icon-192.png.use: Keep it with your brand files; your web person may ask for it.

mobile/icon-512.png.label: App icon, large
mobile/icon-512.png.use: Good as a profile picture where a square logo works best.

mobile/favicon-32.png.label: Browser tab icon
mobile/favicon-32.png.what: The small icon in a browser tab (32 x 32).
mobile/favicon-32.png.use: Keep it with your brand files.

words/words.pdf.label: Copy deck
words/words.pdf.what: Your Google Business Profile description, services and posts, review request texts and replies, and a social bio with captions.
words/words.pdf.use: Paste each piece where it goes. Nothing is posted for you: you stay in control of your profiles.

words/paste-ready.txt.label: Copy deck, plain text
words/paste-ready.txt.what: The same words as plain text.
words/paste-ready.txt.use: Copy and paste from here: no PDF line breaks to clean up.

print/business-cards.pdf.label: Business cards
print/business-cards.pdf.what: Print-ready business cards, front and back, with bleed and crop marks.
print/business-cards.pdf.use: Send the file as it is to any print shop or online printer.

print/glovebox-card.pdf.label: Glovebox card
print/glovebox-card.pdf.what: A card to leave in each car you work on, with codes to save your number and to find you again.
print/glovebox-card.pdf.use: Print it with your business cards and leave one in every car.

print/review-hang-tag.pdf.label: Review hang tag
print/review-hang-tag.pdf.what: A mirror hang tag with a code that opens your Google review page.
print/review-hang-tag.pdf.use: Hang one on the mirror when you hand the car back. Never offer anything in return for a review.

print/counter-card.pdf.label: Counter card
print/counter-card.pdf.what: A small stand-up card with a code to your Google review page.
print/counter-card.pdf.use: Put it where customers pay or pick up their keys.

social/share-1200x630.png.label: Share image
social/share-1200x630.png.what: An image sized for link previews (1200 x 630), in your colors.
social/share-1200x630.png.use: Post it as a launch picture; whoever edits your site can also set it as the link preview.

social/facebook-cover.png.label: Facebook cover
social/facebook-cover.png.what: A cover photo sized for your Facebook page.
social/facebook-cover.png.use: Upload it as your Facebook cover photo.

social/profile-800.png.label: Profile picture
social/profile-800.png.what: A square profile picture with your logo.
social/profile-800.png.use: Use it on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and your Google profile.

social/post-1.png.label: Launch post 1
social/post-1.png.what: A ready-made post announcing your new site.
social/post-1.png.use: Post it with its caption from captions.txt.

social/post-2.png.label: Launch post 2
social/post-2.png.use: Post it a few days after the first one.

social/story-1080x1920.png.label: Story
social/story-1080x1920.png.what: A full-screen story image for Instagram or Facebook.
social/story-1080x1920.png.use: Share it as a story with your website link.

social/captions.txt.label: Captions
social/captions.txt.what: A caption written for each social image.
social/captions.txt.use: Copy the caption that goes with the image you post.
